description: AAASM-5353 positive, added after review: the other half of the boundary rule. A 統一編號 carrying an explicit label is still found inside a machine-delimited structure, which is where a real one actually appears in an API payload. Without this exemption the tightened boundary rule would simply switch the recognizer off for structured data. Weighted digit-sum 39; the seventh digit is 7, arming the historical exception, so 39+1 = 40 satisfies both era rules.
